name: Chicago 95
description: A retro desktop OS design system rebuilt for the modern web. Beveled silver chrome, navy title bars, and pixel-tight typography evoke the chunky charm of mid-90s computing.
concept: Chicago 95 reinterprets the classic operating-system look as a reusable component language. Every surface is a window: 2-pixel outset bevels carve light and shadow into silver panels, navy headers anchor each frame, and the iconic teal desktop ties the screen together. Type stays small, monospace where it matters, and icons stay crisp and outlined so the whole system feels like a workstation booting up.

palette.name: Desktop Teal
palette.role: Primary page background and desktop surface

palette.name: Window Silver
palette.role: Chrome, panels, button faces, and tab strips

palette.name: Title Navy
palette.role: Active window title bars and primary accent

palette.name: Bevel Highlight
palette.role: Top and left bevel highlights on raised surfaces

palette.name: Bevel Shadow
palette.role: Bottom and right bevel shadows and dividers

palette.name: Deep Shadow
palette.role: Outer frame edge, text, and inset shadows

palette.name: Workspace Paper
palette.role: Document, code, and input field surfaces

palette.name: Alert Yellow
palette.role: Warning highlights and signature focus accents

fonts.name: VT323
fonts.usage: Display headings and the signature pixel terminal element

fonts.name: Pixelify Sans
fonts.usage: UI labels, buttons, tabs, and body text in window chrome

fonts.name: JetBrains Mono
fonts.usage: Code blocks, line numbers, and monospace data fields

iconPack.name: Tabler Icons
iconPack.usage: Outline icons sit inside beveled chrome buttons, title-bar controls, tab strips, and toolbar groups to mimic dense OS-style toolbars.
